item.title: Mars Hill Bible pulls out gritty win over Bayside Academy in 3A State Championship
item.description: Mars Hill Bible defeated Bayside Academy 38-21 to secure back-to-back Alabama 3A State Championships. Jaxon Penn took home the MVP Award in the game after he rushed for 206 yards and three touchdowns on 25 carries. Hudson Higgins also added 195 yards and two rushing touchdowns. item.title: Maplesville gets revenge against Wadley in 1A State Championship
item.description: Maplesville is back on top as state champions after defeating Wadley 42-22 and avenging its loss to the Bulldogs in last year’s Class 1A State Championship. item.title: Alabama announces signing of late running back addition
item.description: Alabama football has announced the signing of Traeshawn Brown on Thursday. Brown is a 2026 running back out of Huntsville High School in Texas. He holds previous offers from Arkansas State, Navy, New Mexico State and others. The new Alabama running back addition is a 5-foot-10, 190-pound explosive back. item.title: Trio of Alabama signees named Gatorade Player of the Year for respective states
item.description: Alabama football’s five-star running back signee, Ezavier Crowell has been named the 2025 Gatorade Player of the Year for the state of Alabama.
